items.example: Who's in it? Do you know the actors?
I like Denzel Washington in it. It's very exciting.

items.idiom: laugh a lot when I watch it
items.example: I laugh a lot when I watch comedies.

items.idiom: Do you like the same films?
items.translation: Вам нравятся одни и те же фильмы?
items.example: Do you like the same films? Why or why not?
Word linking helps you sound more natural.
Is anyone famous in it? I love good acting.
